notes.title: 🚀 Block Dude Deluxe - Major Update! 🚀
notes.content:
Hey Block Dudes!
We’ve been hard at work, and we’re excited to bring you a HUGE update packed with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and expanded level creation tools!

🏗️ New Features

🆕 Level Editor – Create your own levels and share them with the world! Design puzzles, place blocks, and challenge your friends. Learn how to use it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3429660506]here[/url].

🌍 Steam Workshop Support – Upload and download custom levels directly from the Steam Workshop! Browse community-made levels and experience new challenges.

📂 Side-Loading Levels – Want to play levels outside of the Workshop? You can now manually load custom levels into the game.


🔧 Quality of Life Improvements

🎥 Camera Controls – You can now move the camera using WASD for better level navigation.

🖥️ Resizable Window – Resize the game to any size you want! No more fixed window constraints.

💡 More UI & Tips – We've added extra UI elements to help guide you through the game.

This update is all about giving you more control over your gameplay experience and making it easier than ever to create, share, and play new levels. We can’t wait to see what you build!

💬 Let us know what you think in the comments, and as always, thanks for playing!

🔧 Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
There was a bug where an async event wasn't triggering correctly after the last update. That has been fixed.

We now have fully leader-board support, so you can compete to achieve the fastest times in each level!
